observations: Frozen input old bytes and canonical encoded proposed record prevent caller array changes from altering commit bytes.

Exact old/new/install readbacks occur before and after the full validation callback outside the revocation monitor; final monitor contains cheap cancellation, lease assertion, bounded active equality and atomic move.
All transaction-phase Exception subclasses, including coroutine cancellation, yield exact frozen-byte observation or UNKNOWN rather than escaping as a precommit refusal.
Known successful rename followed by unexpected old bytes returns UNKNOWN; failed sync after visible new bytes reports COMMITTED with directorySynced=false; revocation prevents trusted classification.
A transaction directory is never reused/erased. Original and new evidence is retained; no alias/key/ciphertext mutation or automatic rollback.
Fresh-lease reconcile is observational only and cannot confer authentication or session authority.
28 host test methods retain existing boundary coverage and add readback/callback/cancellation/possible-move/lease latency controls. Test outcomes remain coordinator-owned and unreviewed here.
limits: File observations cannot guarantee result delivery through a cancelled parent or Deferred. Later API integration must treat interrupted activation as unknown until fresh-lease inspection.
Host injected file errors and process-local exclusion do not establish actual power-loss or cross-process filesystem safety.
This review creates no app/public activation route or actual Android per-use/physical acceptance.
